module: Root registry of the UI router routes: the single explicit entry point for registering top-level route families. Each `{ include = "name" }` entry mounts the routes/name.lua module (Root + Children). There is no automatic filesystem discovery: a module is registered only if it is listed here (or added at runtime via routeManager.addVueRoutes / registerModRoutes). Read by routeManager.
notes: Global.include designates the module of single-segment global routes (play, /mainmenu...), here "global".
The list contains "livery" although no routes/livery.lua file is present in 0.40.5; only "liveries" exists. This entry is ignored with a warning.

Children.desc: List of `{ include = "module" }` entries: bigmap, campaign, career, debug, default, firstDrive, freeroamLevels, freeroamWizard, garage, legal, livery, liveries, menu, mission, mods, multiseat, multiplayer, options, pause, radial, scenario, taxi, trackBuilder.

Global.desc: `{ include = "global" }`: module of flat global routes (play, /mainmenu, etc.).
